0022600176.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-4, 8th in the East, 0.5 games behind for 3rd in the Southeast) are on a three-game losing streak and 1-2 on the road, and they visit the Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 15th in the East), who won their most recent game but are 0-3 at home. Charlotte is without Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, both out with hamstring injuries, while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both out. The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Brooklyn on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
